correctness.rationale: The icosahedron has 20 oriented face normals and 30 dual adjacencies. An edge silhouettes for generic view u iff adjacent face normal dot-products with u have opposite signs. Exact Q(sqrt5) sign patterns on an icosahedral fundamental spherical triangle of area pi/30 show precisely two active great-circle cuts, partition into 10-, 8- and 6-edge regions. Girard excess with alpha=acos(1/(phi*sqrt3)), beta=acos(1/sqrt3) yields p6=30/pi(alpha+beta-2pi/3), p8=30/pi(pi-alpha-2beta), p10=30/pi(beta-3pi/10). Their sum1, positive, mean 30/pi acos(sqrt5/3). Duality (proj_L I)^polar=I^polar intersection L gives the same count law for central dodecahedral sections. Independently recomputed the exact spherical areas, mean and probabilities; globality depends on exact face adjacency and symmetry tiling, not the 2000 random samples in package.
